title: Handle incomplete contact data
description: Keep missing email and phone as null, normalize optional tags, and flag records needing contact details.

exercise.instruction: Set contact.email to "ada@example.com", then run again.

edgeCases.name: Existing phone and tags are preserved

recipe.problem: Prepare incomplete contact records for a follow-up queue while preserving the distinction between an unknown contact and a known value.
prerequisites: id is required. contact is optional, with optional email and phone text fields or null.
tags is an optional array of text or null. An absent or null tags field means no tags for this workflow.
explanation: The required identifier is checked before producing a result.
contact uses an empty object before reading optional leaves. A missing leaf is null; indexing a null parent would fail.
email and phone stay null when absent or explicitly null. No placeholder contact detail is invented.
tags uses an empty collection only for absent or null tags. needs_contact is true when both contact fields are null.
limits: This checks presence only. Blank strings count as present; normalize and validate contacts first when blank text should mean missing.
Wrong input types are outside this recipe schema; tags must be an array when supplied.
The program does not send messages or update customer records.
